evals.name: dotnet-project-and-package-edges-are-cited
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-dependencies

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The repository has src/App/App.csproj with a ProjectReference to src/Lib/Lib.csproj and a PackageReference to Newtonsoft.Json. No dependency-graph.json exists yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs dependency-graph.sh on the repository root, writes dependency-graph.json in the one-object-per-line layout, and renders dependency-graph.md as a mermaid flowchart of the internal edge. The package is collapsed. Every edge's evidence names the csproj and the declaration.
expectations: Runs ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/dependency-graph.sh and writes its stdout to docs/architecture/dependency-graph.json without pretty-printing it
Renders with render-dependencies.sh rather than drawing the flowchart by hand
The App to Lib edge is a resolved project edge whose evidence includes the ProjectReference declaration
Newtonsoft.Json is a package edge and is absent from the default mermaid flowchart
The closing report quotes the renderer's summary line

evals.name: unrecognized-ecosystem-is-unknown
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-dependencies

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The repository has a Gemfile and no .NET project file. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: Writes a dependency-graph.json whose result is unknown and whose message names Gemfile, and a dependency-graph.md with that message and no mermaid flowchart.
expectations: result is unknown, not ok with an empty node list presented as a graph of no dependencies
The message names Gemfile and says an empty graph was not invented
Does not parse dependencies out of the Gemfile
Does not ask the operator to pick an ecosystem

evals.name: outside-project-reference-stays-unresolved
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-dependencies

The convention home resolves. src/App/App.csproj has a ProjectReference whose Include path leaves the repository root. A project with the same file name exists inside the repository at a different path, and again as a sibling checkout outside the root.
evals.expected_output: The edge is status unresolved and its to field is the declared relative path. Neither the inside decoy nor the outside checkout is used as the target.
expectations: Does not search the disk for a project with the same file name
Does not read any directory outside the repository root
The closing report says the reference was not matched by name

evals.name: cycle-is-at-the-top-and-imports-are-ignored
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-dependencies --cycles-only

The convention home resolves. Three projects reference each other in a directed cycle. One of them also has a C# file with a using directive for a fourth name that no project file references.
evals.expected_output: The cycle is listed at the top of dependency-graph.md, above the mermaid flowchart. The using directive produces no edge. The diagram is a flowchart, not a C4 diagram.
expectations: The Cycles section appears above the Diagram section and names the three projects
Must not add an edge from a using directive or any other source import
The rendered diagram is a mermaid flowchart, never a C4Component or C4Container block
Passes --cycles-only to render-dependencies.sh rather than deleting edges from the JSON
